verdict.rationale: Synthesia's docs cover most of the loop for an agent. The Video API is asynchronous: you submit a job, then poll or receive a webhook when it's ready. The response gives a time-limited .mp4 download link, and a Billing API returns the workspace's billing period and credit balance. A machine-readable llms.txt and an MCP server for creating videos from AI tools support doing this from docs alone. Missing for 10: per-job cost reporting (only workspace credit balance is documented), evidence that the Video API accepts free-form prompts rather than scripted inputs, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running the loop end to end.
